label: Disease
name: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: A chronic, progressive fibrosing interstitial pneumonia of unknown cause, occurring primarily in older adults, limited to the lungs, and associated with progressive worsening of dyspnea and lung function.

label: Drug
name: Imatinib
description: Selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting BCR-ABL, PDGFRalpha/beta, and c-KIT; investigated for antifibrotic properties in IPF.

label: Drug
name: Nintedanib
description: Triple angiokinase inhibitor simultaneously blocking VEGFR1-3, FGFR1-3, and PDGFRalpha/beta kinase activity.

label: Drug
name: Pamrevlumab
description: Recombinant human IgG1 monoclonal antibody neutralizing connective tissue growth factor (CTGF / CCN2).

label: Drug
name: Pirfenidone
description: Antifibrotic pyridone derivative that downregulates TGF-beta production, reduces collagen synthesis, and suppresses myofibroblast differentiation.

label: Drug
name: Treprostinil
description: Synthetic analogue of prostacyclin activating PTGIR, stimulating intracellular cAMP, promoting pulmonary vasodilation and inhibiting fibroblast proliferation.

label: Hypothesis
name: Selective PDGF/c-Kit Tyrosine Kinase Blockade Fails in Clinical Human IPF
description: Although selective PDGF receptor and c-KIT blockade attenuates fibrosis in murine bleomycin models, human Phase 2 trials demonstrated lack of clinical benefit on survival or FVC, demonstrating redundant cytokine drives (FGFR, TGF-beta) in human pathogenesis.

label: Hypothesis
name: Simultaneous Triple-Angiokinase Receptor Inhibition Slows Lung Function Loss in IPF
description: Concurrent blockade of FGFR, PDGFR, and VEGFR cascades inhibits fibroblast proliferation, migration, and extracellular matrix deposition, overcoming compensatory signaling loops to slow FVC decline in IPF.

label: Protein
name: Mast/stem cell growth factor receptor Kit

label: ResearchPaper
name: Imatinib as a Novel Antifibrotic Agent in Bleomycin-Induced Pulmonary Fibrosis in Mice
description: Preclinical investigation in murine bleomycin models demonstrated that imatinib attenuated lung fibrosis and collagen accumulation by blocking PDGF receptor phosphorylation in lung fibroblasts, providing the initial preclinical hypothesis for clinical testing.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Pirfenidone in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Phase II Clinical Evaluation
description: A double-blind, randomized trial of pirfenidone versus placebo demonstrated significant reduction in the rate of decline in vital capacity and a significant reduction in the frequency of acute exacerbations of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.

label: ResearchPaper
name: A Randomized, Controlled Trial of Imatinib in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: In this randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of 119 IPF patients, imatinib mesylate 600 mg daily did not affect survival (HR 0.94; 95% CI 0.44-2.02) or the rate of FVC decline over 96 weeks. These findings demonstrate that targeting the PDGF receptor alone is not sufficient to halt progressive fibrogenesis in human disease.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Mode of Action of Nintedanib (BIBF 1120) as an Antifibrotic and Antiangiogenic Agent
description: BIBF 1120 was identified as an indolinone derivative that concurrently inhibits receptor tyrosine kinases VEGFR, FGFR and PDGFR at low nanomolar concentrations, preventing ligand-dependent autophosphorylation and mitogenesis.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Efficacy and Safety of Nintedanib in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: In two 52-week, randomized, double-blind, phase 3 trials (INPULSIS-1 and INPULSIS-2) involving 1066 patients, nintedanib significantly slowed disease progression by reducing the annual rate of decline in forced vital capacity in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (-114.7 mL/year vs -239.9 mL/year in INPULSIS-1; -113.6 mL/year vs -207.3 mL/year in INPULSIS-2).

label: ResearchPaper
name: A Phase 3 Trial of Pirfenidone in Patients with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: The ASCEND trial confirmed that pirfenidone significantly reduced disease progression in patients with IPF, meeting the primary endpoint of slowing the rate of decline in forced vital capacity, along with positive effects on secondary endpoints.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Fibroblast Growth Factor Receptor Signaling Promotes Pulmonary Fibrosis via Epithelial Mesenchymal Transition
description: Evaluation of human idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis biopsies demonstrated hyperactivation of FGFR1 and FGFR2 in alveolar epithelial cells and fibroblastic foci, driving epithelial-mesenchymal transition and extracellular matrix secretion.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Receptor Tyrosine Kinase Redundancy Explains Resistance to Monotherapy in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: Pharmacological analysis reveals that single-target kinase inhibition (such as selective PDGF receptor blockade with imatinib) permits compensatory activation of fibroblast growth factor (FGF) and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) signaling cascades, explaining clinical resistance and failure of single-agent monotargeting.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Connective Tissue Growth Factor Neutralization Attenuates Preclinical Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: Monoclonal antibody blockade of CTGF (CCN2) with FG-3019 suppressed lung collagen deposition and improved histology in murine pulmonary fibrosis models, serving as the biological proof of concept preceding human randomized clinical testing.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Nintedanib in Patients with Progressive Fibrosing Interstitial Lung Diseases (INBUILD Trial)
description: In patients with progressive fibrosing interstitial lung diseases, the annual rate of decline in forced vital capacity was significantly lower in patients who received nintedanib than in those who received placebo (-80.8 mL/year vs -187.8 mL/year), showing shared fibrotic signaling across etiologies.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Inhaled Treprostinil in Pulmonary Hypertension Due to Interstitial Lung Disease (INCREASE Trial)
description: In patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), inhaled treprostinil improved 6-minute walk distance by 31 meters compared with placebo and significantly reduced NT-proBNP levels and clinical worsening events.

label: ResearchPaper
name: Trial of Pamrevlumab in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of the Phase 3 ZEPHYRUS-1 Study
description: In the Phase 3 ZEPHYRUS-1 trial, pamrevlumab (anti-CTGF mAb) did not show a statistically significant difference in FVC decline versus placebo at week 48, highlighting that targeting connective tissue growth factor alone did not replicate Phase 2 promise.
